# firezone_group_members (Data Source)

Lists the Actors that are members of a Group. For the managed Everyone Group, this is every user and admin Actor; service accounts and API clients are not members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "firezone_group" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

data "firezone_group_members" "engineering" {
  group_id = data.firezone_group.engineering.id
}

output "engineering_emails" {
  value = [for m in data.firezone_group_members.engineering.members : m.email if m.email != null]
}

# The built-in Everyone Group has type "managed". Its members are every
# user and admin Actor in the account.
data "firezone_group" "everyone" {
  name = "Everyone"
}

data "firezone_group_members" "everyone" {
  group_id = data.firezone_group.everyone.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of the Group to list.

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The Group's members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The Actor's email address, or null if it has none.
- `id` (String) Actor ID.
- `name` (String) Actor name.
- `type` (String) One of account_user, account_admin_user, service_account, api_client.
